_README.purpose: Input contract for the WC2026 squad update. The real version of this file is filled on/after 2 June 2026 from the chosen FIFA source (see CLAUDE_CODE_BRIEF.md §2).
_README.WARNING: The example team below is ILLUSTRATIVE FORMAT ONLY. The players are placeholders ('Player 01' etc.) and are NOT a real squad. Do not load the example into the app.

field_groups.official: Comes from FIFA. shirt_number, position, name, club, age, caps. A player is included ONLY if the FIFA source lists them.
field_groups.app: The app's own editorial creations, NOT from FIFA: overall, stats{pac,sho,pas,dri,def,phy}, badges, bio, featured. Filled by Claude during data prep. New players rated on the same scale as existing cards (brief §6); retained players keep their existing values.

_README.position_codes: GK = goalkeeper, DF = defender, MF = midfielder, FW = forward. Minimum 3 GK per squad; 23-26 players total.
_README.source_field: Set 'source' to 'fifa.com' when a team is pasted directly from the FIFA article, otherwise 'wikipedia:2026_FIFA_World_Cup_squads' for the verbatim transcription. fifa.com is always the authority. Keep it honest per team.

teams.name: EXAMPLE TEAM — ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY, NOT REAL DATA
teams.intro: <<2-4 sentence team intro, paraphrased from the FIFA article. Leave blank if no FIFA text available.>>

app._note: New player -> Claude fills overall/stats/bio/badges on the same scale as existing cards (brief §6). Retained player -> copy existing app fields from current App.jsx, do not overwrite.
